1.name: Fully Automatic High-Precision Laminating Machine
1.summary: Specifically designed for glass and display module assembly. Lamination accuracy reaches ±0.075mm, equipped with constant pressure control, and cycle time as fast as 80 seconds.
1.contentHtml:
The Fully Automatic High-Precision Laminating Machine is a high-end intelligent equipment independently developed by TXAM, specifically designed for high-precision lamination of glass and display modules.

Working Principle

The equipment adopts a precision mechanical structure combined with an advanced motion control system to achieve automatic feeding, precise positioning, high-precision lamination, and pressure holding. The entire process is automatically controlled to ensure lamination accuracy and consistent quality.

Technical Advantages

  • Lamination accuracy reaches ±0.075mm, far exceeding industry standards
  • Constant pressure function ensures firm lamination without bubbles
  • Ultra-fast 80-second cycle time significantly improves production efficiency
  • Supports multiple product sizes with high flexibility

Application Areas

Widely used in glass lamination processes for electronic products such as TVs, educational displays, and commercial display screens.

2.name: OC Intelligent Lamination System
2.summary: Fully automatic precision assembly of Open Cell and backlight modules. Utilizes UVW vision alignment platform to completely eliminate screen breakage issues caused by manual lamination.
2.contentHtml:
The OC Intelligent Lamination System is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for the core processes of display panel production.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a UVW vision alignment platform to automatically identify product positions and guide the robot to complete precision assembly of OC and backlight modules. The fully automatic process includes automatic feeding, foam collection, and empty box collection.

Technical Advantages

  • Lamination accuracy ranges from ±0.15mm to ±0.4mm
  • Fixed cycle time of 25 seconds ensures production rhythm
  • Completely eliminates screen breakage issues caused by manual lamination
  • One-click product changeover reduces changeover time

Model Description

The TXM-A series includes models such as 151B, 201B, and 401B, with the main differences being compatible product sizes and lamination accuracy.

4.name: High-Precision Robotic Dispensing Machine
4.summary: Single-axis robot combined with multi-nozzle matrix, positioning error ±0.2mm, single line dispensing only 0.25 seconds. Seamless CAD drawing import for one-click changeover.
4.contentHtml:
The high-precision robotic dispensing machine is a core equipment developed by TXAM for precision coating processes.

Working Principle

It uses a single-axis robot combined with a multi-nozzle matrix to achieve fast and uniform dispensing through a precision motion control system. Supports direct import of CAD drawings to automatically generate dispensing paths.

Technical Advantages

  • Positioning error of only ±0.2mm, industry-leading precision
  • Dispensing speed of 0.25 seconds per row, extremely high efficiency
  • Supports one-click CAD drawing import for easy changeover
  • TCP/IP communication protocol, easy to integrate into smart factory systems

Model Description

The TX-NS-AGD-01 uses a fixture tray format, while the TX-NS-AGD-02 uses direct backplane feeding, with the main difference being the production line compatibility method.

5.name: Automatic Spray Gluing Machine
5.summary: Sprays glue evenly onto the target object, suitable for larger-sized panels. High spraying efficiency and strong compatibility, from 75" to full-size compatibility.
5.contentHtml:
The automatic spray gluing machine is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for large-panel glue spraying needs.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a glue block melter feeding method, heating and melting solid glue blocks, then spraying them evenly onto the product surface through a nozzle. Fast spraying speed and uniform coating.

Technical Advantages

  • Spraying speed of 0.6-0.8m/s, industry-leading efficiency
  • Compatible sizes from 75" to full size, wide application range
  • Multiple models TX-NS-ASM-01/02/03 available
  • Can be paired with vision or mechanical positioning

6.name: Automatic Light Bracket Placement Machine
6.summary: Precisely picks and places diffusion brackets, providing stable support for display device optical components. Accurate positioning and high-speed picking.
6.contentHtml:
The automatic light bracket placement machine is used for precise placement of diffusion bracket posts during display product assembly.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a vibration bowl for automatic feeding, and the robot precisely picks bracket posts and places them at designated positions. Positioning accuracy reaches ±0.2mm, with a picking speed of 1 second per piece.

Technical Advantages

  • Positioning accuracy of ±0.2mm, ensuring assembly precision
  • High-speed picking, capable of thousands per hour
  • Automatic vibration bowl feeding reduces manual intervention
  • Multiple models TX-NS-ALPS-01/02/03, adaptable to different sizes and production needs

7.name: Automatic Light Bar Placement Machine
7.summary: Precisely and quickly places LED light bars at designated positions. Can pick multiple light bars at once, with pressure holding function to ensure assembly accuracy.
7.contentHtml:
The automatic light bar placement machine uses a robotic unit to automate light bar placement.

Working Principle

It uses a robot with a vision system to precisely pick 7 light bars and place them at target positions in one go. The equipment has a pressure holding function to ensure the light bars are firmly fixed.

Technical Advantages

  • Assembly accuracy of ±0.2mm
  • Can pick 7 light bars at once, high efficiency
  • Pressure holding function ensures assembly quality
  • Supports CAD import for quick changeover

8.name: Robot Automatic Backplane Screw Machine
8.summary: Capable of grabbing and automatically tightening up to 12 back panel screws at once, with real-time adjustable torque per screw, achieving an efficiency of 1.8 seconds per screw.
8.contentHtml:
The robotic automatic back panel screw machine is an automation device developed by TXAM for precision fastening processes.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a robot combined with an intelligent fastening system, capable of grabbing 12 screws at once and automatically fastening them onto the product. Torque is adjustable in real time to ensure consistent fastening torque for each screw.

Technical Advantages

  • Can grab 12 screws at once, reducing feeding frequency
  • Fastening speed of 1.8 seconds per screw, extremely efficient
  • Real-time adjustable torque ensures fastening quality
  • Suitable for back panel fastening of TVs, educational monitors, etc.

9.name: 180-degree heavy-duty flipper
9.summary: Designed for flipping large or heavy products, achieving precise 180-degree flipping. Solves difficulties and safety issues of manual flipping due to process requirements.
9.contentHtml:
The 180-degree heavy-duty flipper is a core device developed by TXAM for flipping large and heavy products.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a precision mechanical structure combined with a servo drive system to achieve one-button 180-degree flipping. The flipping process is smooth with precise positioning, effectively solving the difficulties and safety hazards of manual flipping.

Technical Advantages

  • Flipping cycle time of 15-55 seconds, high efficiency
  • One-button operation, simple and convenient
  • High load capacity, suitable for large products like TVs and educational monitors
  • Multiple models available: TXM-B-105 series (A/B/C) and 205A

10.name: Automatic tempered glass frame installation machine
10.summary: Automatically installs tempered glass frames for educational monitors. Uses vision positioning with accuracy up to ±0.15mm.
10.contentHtml:
The automatic tempered glass frame installation machine is an automated assembly unit developed by TXAM for educational display products.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a CCD vision system to automatically identify product positions, guiding the robot to complete precise tempered glass frame installation. Positioning accuracy is up to ±0.15mm.

Technical Advantages

  • Positioning accuracy of ±0.15mm, industry-leading
  • Uses vision positioning, strong adaptability
  • TX-NS-ACTGR-02 model has faster cycle time
  • Specifically designed for educational display products

11.name: Six-axis robot intelligent palletizing system
specs: Compatible with master and slave pallets
11.summary: Perfectly solves heavy product palletizing challenges. Supports simulator palletizing and master/slave pallets, with accuracy controlled within ±0.5mm and speed up to 12 seconds per piece.
11.contentHtml:
The six-axis robot intelligent palletizing system is a core device developed by TXAM for post-production line logistics automation.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a six-axis industrial robot (optional ABB, Yaskawa, etc.) combined with an intelligent control system to achieve automatic product palletizing. Supports simulator palletizing and master/slave pallets, with strong compatibility.

Technical Advantages

  • Palletizing accuracy of ±0.5mm, neat and stable stacking
  • Efficiency up to 12 seconds per piece
  • Supports simulator palletizing and master/slave pallets
  • Compatible with products of different sizes and shapes

Model Description

TX-NS-PR series (01/02/03) and integrated palletizing TX-NS-RIP-001, the latter with more powerful functions including master/slave pallet stacking, automatic pad placement, scanning, etc.

12.name: End-of-Line Upright Packaging Automatic Cartoning System
12.summary: Integrated automatic pallet stacking (skid), case unpacking, forming, and machine cartoning. Mechanically rigid positioning with full compatibility, completing single skid centering in 20 seconds.
12.contentHtml:
The End-of-Line Upright Packaging Automatic Cartoning System is an automated device developed by TXAM for post-packaging processes.

Working Principle

The system integrates an automatic palletizer, case unpacker, case former, and cartoning machine to automate the entire post-production packaging process. One-button operation automatically completes pallet stacking and centering.

Technical Advantages

  • Pallet centering cycle time of only 20 seconds per piece
  • Mechanically rigid positioning for enhanced compatibility
  • Allows for a certain range of pallet offset
  • Multiple models available: TX-NS-AET-01/02/03

13.name: Integrated Robot Palletizing Solution
13.summary: A more powerful integrated palletizing solution, including master-slave pallet stacking, automatic slip sheet placement, scanning, and other special functions.
13.contentHtml:
The Integrated Robot Palletizing Solution is a full-featured palletizing system developed by TXAM for high-end customers.

Working Principle

Based on standard palletizing functions, it integrates master-slave pallet stacking, automatic slip sheet placement, and scanning to automate the entire post-production logistics process.

Technical Advantages

  • Complete functionality covering the entire post-production logistics process
  • Master-slave pallet stacking function for more application scenarios
  • Automatic slip sheet placement reduces manual intervention
  • Scanning function enables traceable logistics information

14.name: Robot Uprighting Unit
14.summary: Automatically converts products from horizontal to vertical orientation. Uses CCD vision to determine product position, and the robot automatically picks and completes the uprighting action.
14.contentHtml:
The Robot Uprighting Unit is an automated device developed by TXAM for product orientation conversion.

Working Principle

The device uses a CCD vision system to automatically determine the product position, guiding a six-axis robot to pick the product and complete the orientation conversion from horizontal to vertical. The uprighting process is smooth, effectively protecting product safety.

Technical Advantages

  • CCD vision guidance for accurate positioning
  • Smooth uprighting process to avoid product damage
  • Significantly reduces labor and improves efficiency
  • Customizable based on different product characteristics

15.name: Auxiliary Vision Inspection Unit
15.summary: Through automatic flipping and image recognition, assist or replace manual labor in product appearance quality inspection. Solve the difficulty of manually flipping heavy products.
15.contentHtml:
The auxiliary visual inspection unit is an automated auxiliary equipment developed by TXAM for product quality inspection.

Working Principle

The equipment automatically flips the product and works with the image recognition system to assist in completing product appearance quality inspection. Effectively solves the difficulty of manually flipping heavy products.

Technical Advantages

  • Automatic flipping function, solving the difficulty of flipping heavy products
  • Works with the vision system to improve inspection accuracy
  • Significantly improves appearance inspection efficiency
  • Reduces employee labor intensity

16.name: Automatic Pressure Holding Unit
16.summary: Apply and maintain constant pressure on assembled components to ensure bonding or assembly process quality. Precise pressure control, long pressure holding time.
16.contentHtml:
The automatic pressure holding unit is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for bonding processes.

Working Principle

The equipment applies constant pressure to products that have completed processes such as dispensing and lamination, ensuring the adhesive fully cures and the assembly quality is stable and consistent.

Technical Advantages

  • Precise pressure control, ensuring bonding quality
  • Long pressure holding time, adapting to different process requirements
  • Strong adaptability, can be used with various products
  • Automated operation, reducing manual intervention

17.name: Industrial Brain Control Software R&D
17.summary: Deep integration of software and hardware, independently developed WMS, WCS, MES, and underlying TCP/IP vision communication components. Break down workshop information silos and achieve digital transparent management.
17.contentHtml:
The Industrial Brain control software is a software system independently developed by TXAM for smart factory implementation.

System Components

The system includes WMS Warehouse Management System, WCS Warehouse Control System, MES Manufacturing Execution System, and underlying TCP/IP vision communication components.

Technical Advantages

  • Break down workshop information silos, achieving data interconnection
  • Real-time monitoring of equipment status and production data
  • Digital transparent management, improving management efficiency
  • Supports TCP/IP communication, seamlessly connecting with various devices

Application Scenarios

Suitable for intelligent transformation and upgrade of various automated production lines, achieving true smart manufacturing.

18.name: Rotary Table
18.summary: A precision rotary device for multi-station processing or inspection of products, enabling multi-angle automated handling.
18.contentHtml:
The rotary table is an automated unit equipment developed by TXAM for multi-station processing needs.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a precision servo drive system to achieve multi-angle rotation positioning of products. Working with an automated loading and unloading system, it can complete multi-station processes such as machining, inspection, and assembly.

Technical Advantages

  • Precision positioning, high repeatability
  • Multi-station design, improving production efficiency
  • High degree of automation, reducing manual intervention
  • Strong adaptability, can be used with various products

19.name: Lifting Unit
19.summary: Lifting and conveying equipment for transferring products between workstations at different heights, enabling seamless production line integration.
19.contentHtml:
The lifting unit is an automated conveying equipment developed by TXAM for seamless production line height transitions.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a servo drive system combined with precision guide rails to achieve smooth product lifting. It is suitable for product transfer between workstations at different heights, enabling seamless production line integration.

Technical Advantages

  • Smooth lifting with high load capacity
  • Automated control for perfect integration with production lines
  • Stable structure with long service life
  • Customizable stroke and load

20.name: Module transfer machine
20.summary: Precision equipment for automatic transfer of electronic modules between different workstations, supporting multiple product sizes.
20.contentHtml:
The module transfer machine is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for electronic module transfer.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a precision motion control system to achieve accurate module transfer between multiple workstations. Combined with a vision positioning system, it adapts to precise transfer of products of different sizes.

Technical Advantages

  • High transfer accuracy with precise product positioning
  • Supports multi-station configuration with high flexibility
  • High degree of automation, reducing manual intervention
  • Easy changeover, adaptable to multi-variety production

21.name: Automatic clip and latch machine
21.summary: Automated equipment for automatic installation of clips or latches, with precision positioning for quick latching assembly.
21.contentHtml:
The automatic clip and latch machine is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for clip assembly.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a precision mechanical structure combined with servo drive to achieve automatic gripping, positioning, and installation of clips or latches. Equipped with a vision inspection system to ensure latching quality.

Technical Advantages

  • Automatic latching assembly with high efficiency
  • Precision positioning with high assembly accuracy
  • Equipped with vision inspection for guaranteed quality
  • Adapts to products of multiple sizes

22.name: Auxiliary bag sealing machine
22.summary: Automated sealing equipment for product packaging bags, using heat sealing technology for neat and strong seals.
22.contentHtml:
The auxiliary bag sealing machine is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for the packaging sealing process.

Working Principle

The equipment uses heat sealing technology to automatically seal product packaging bags. Combined with an automatic feeding system, it achieves full automation of the sealing process.

Technical Advantages

  • Heat sealing technology for neat and strong seals
  • High degree of automation with high efficiency
  • Consistent quality control with uniform sealing quality
  • Easy operation with low maintenance costs

23.name: Robot Offline Bagging
23.summary: Automatically completes the bagging process after product offline in collaboration with robots, achieving full automation of post-packaging.
23.contentHtml:
The Robot Offline Bagging Machine is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for the post-packaging process.

Working Principle

The equipment works with a six-axis robot to automatically grab packaging bags and place them onto products, enabling automated bagging for offline products.

Technical Advantages

  • Robotic automation for high efficiency
  • Precise bagging position for better product protection
  • High automation level, reducing manual labor
  • Adaptable to various product sizes

24.name: Automatic Backplane Placement Robot
24.summary: Used for automatically placing backplanes into product assembly stations, working with robots for precision assembly.
24.contentHtml:
The Automatic Backplane Placement Robot is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for the backplane placement process.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a robot with a precision positioning system to automatically grab and place backplanes into product assembly stations. It works collaboratively with assembly robots to achieve full automation of backplane installation.

Technical Advantages

  • Robotic automatic placement for high efficiency
  • Precise positioning ensuring assembly accuracy
  • High automation level, reducing manual intervention
  • Stable quality control for consistent product quality

26.name: Robot Cell Equipment
26.summary: Modular unit equipment centered around robots, flexibly configurable and integrable based on process requirements.
26.contentHtml:
Robot unit equipment is a modular automation device developed by TXAM for flexible production.

Working Principle

The equipment is centered around a six-axis robot, combined with various end-of-arm tools and auxiliary devices to form a modular unit. It can be flexibly configured according to different process requirements, enabling one machine to perform multiple tasks.

Technical Advantages

  • Modular design, flexible configuration
  • One machine for multiple uses, improving equipment utilization
  • Easy to integrate into existing production lines
  • Efficient and reliable, simple maintenance

27.name: Auxiliary Loading Flip Unit
27.summary: Auxiliary flip device for product loading stations, working with the main equipment to achieve automated loading and unloading.
27.contentHtml:
The Auxiliary Loading Flip Unit is an auxiliary flip device developed by TXAM for production line loading stations.

Working Principle

The equipment works with the main production line to automatically flip and position products at the loading station, preparing them for the next process.

Technical Advantages

  • Automatic flipping, improving loading efficiency
  • Efficient collaboration with the main equipment
  • Quality assurance, reducing product damage
  • Easy to operate, low maintenance costs

28.name: Auxiliary Unloading Flip Unit
28.summary: Auxiliary flip device for product unloading stations, working with the main equipment to achieve automated unloading.
28.contentHtml:
The Auxiliary Unloading Flip Unit is an auxiliary flip device developed by TXAM for production line unloading stations.

Working Principle

The equipment works with the main production line to automatically flip and collect products at the unloading station, preparing them for post-packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • Automatic flipping, improving unloading efficiency
  • Efficient collaboration with the main equipment
  • Quality assurance, reducing product damage
  • Easy to operate, low maintenance costs

29.name: Manual-Assisted Bagging
29.summary: Manual-assisted bagging equipment, working with automated machinery to complete product bagging packaging.
29.contentHtml:
The Manual-Assisted Bagging Machine is a manual-assisted device developed by TXAM for the bagging packaging process.

Working Principle

The equipment works with manual operation to achieve semi-automated bagging packaging, improving packaging efficiency while reducing equipment investment.

Technical Advantages

  • Combination of manual and automation, flexible and efficient
  • Guaranteed bagging quality
  • Reduced equipment investment costs
  • Easy to operate, low training costs

30.name: Robot Automatic Overhead Conveyor Loading
30.summary: An automated device that works with robots to automatically load products onto an overhead conveyor chain.
30.contentHtml:
The Robot Automatic Overhead Conveyor Loading machine is an automated device developed by TXAM for overhead conveying.

Working Principle

The device works with a six-axis robot to automatically pick up products and load them onto the overhead conveyor chain, enabling automatic product loading and overhead conveying.

Technical Advantages

  • Robot-automated overhead loading, high efficiency
  • Overhead conveying saves floor space
  • High level of automation reduces labor
  • Perfect integration with production lines
